summary: Availability of a mission, a unit or an award is one string test against the player-profile block at game+650h. 007FC820 is an all-of over the vector<NativeString> at record+78h; 007FC4C0 is an any-of over the ' ,'-separated tokens of one requirement string, tried against five profile containers in a fixed order. The game's own Lua name for 007FC4C0 is Scoring_IsUnlocked (008BBC40).

container.combination: all-of; empty container returns AL = 1 at 007FC844

element.note: There is no tagged requirement record. The element is a plain string; the 'kind' is decided at evaluation time by which profile container answers.

token.split: _strtok, so runs of separators collapse and no empty token is produced
token.combination: any-of; the accumulated byte is tested at 007FC554 and returned, so the first satisfied token ends the walk
token.empty: no tokens means false, so an empty requirement string locks its subject

missions.note: No shipped entry holds more than one element and none contains a separator, so both the multi-token any-of and the multi-element all-of are unexercised by shipped data.

token_shapes.answered_by: the Unlocks set at profile+70h or the pending set at profile+7Ch

evaluator.name: BSP_Profile_IsUnlockSatisfied
evaluator.abi: __thiscall char (this = game+650h, const NativeString* requirement), RET 4

steps.action: reads requirement->data; a null pointer becomes the empty string at 00f8745c
copies it into char[256] at ESP+64h with an unbounded copy loop; a requirement longer than 255 bytes smashes the native frame
returns the accumulated result at the head of the next iteration

sources.meaning: the mission of that id is completed
the unlock is in the saved 'Unlocks' set
the unlock was granted this session and not yet flushed

sources.test: TEST EAX,EAX; JG, so strictly greater than zero
sources.meaning: a named counter: RANK and the award names

sources.test: found in the list at profile+D0h

evaluator.case_sensitivity: all five are case-insensitive: 004c7f10, 004c8b80 (inside 005097d0) and 0090c100 (inside 0090c560) order through BSP_NativeString_LessCaseInsensitive 00443d00; 007f8890 compares length then __stricmp
evaluator.asymmetry: source 1 accepts any non-zero value; source 4 requires strictly positive

unlock_lifecycle: mission Lua Scoring_GrantUnlock(id) -> profile+7Ch; the debriefing screen 0062c2c0 lists profile+7Ch under FE.scoring_unlockedunit and calls 007fb990, which inserts every entry into profile+70h and empties profile+7Ch; 007fdf00 saves profile+70h as 'Unlocks'. The predicate accepts an id in either set, so a grant counts immediately.

uncertainties: The mission-completion object at profile+64h is 24h bytes; only its map at offset 0 was read.

Whether the two unlock containers are std::set<NativeString> or a map with a zero-size mapped type is not distinguishable: 004d0640 links a node whose value is the bare 8-byte string and 004c7f10 compares against node+0ch, with no mapped field touched.
007fdb20 seeds map["RANK"] = 1, so a token 'RANK' would always pass. No shipped data uses it.
No shipped requirement exercises more than one token or more than one element; the any-of and all-of shapes are recovered from code only.
007fdf00 was read by grep over its listing for the two unlock keys, not end to end; the section layout and Version handling are not recovered.

docs/GAME_TITLE_INIT.md records +74h, +80h and +8Ch as three std::lists; they are the _Myhead fields of three case-insensitive std::set<NativeString> trees at +70h, +7Ch and +88h. The same doc's keyed RANK map is the one at +A0h.

follow_up_packets.contract: The section format BSP_PlayerProfile_Serialize reads and writes, which of the 21 keys map to which offsets in the game+650h block, and what the 24h-byte mission-progress object holds beyond its map.
The 6Ch-byte unlock row at screen+3C8h, how vehicleclasses.lua fills it, and what the locked flag at +45h changes in FE.taclib_unlocks_help and fe/lobby/unlock_disabled.tga.
How the debriefing screen builds the FE.scoring_unlockedunit list from profile+7Ch and when it flushes into profile+70h.
Who fills the list at profile+D0h, and what UnlockDLCMinimum gates.
